title: Higher airfares as fuel surcharge rises in November

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Travelers flying in and out of the Philippines in early November may need to pay more for tickets, as airlines will raise the allowable fuel surcharge to its highest level since May. In an advisory on Tuesday, the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) raised the fuel surcharge to Level 17 for Nov. 1 to 15, up one notch from Level 16 during the second half of October.
